evidence: The precursor dosing and purging times sequence of the ALD reaction can be written as n*t1-t2-m*t3-t4, where t1 and t3 denotes the dose time of the reactants while t2 and t4 represents the purge time with N2 gas. Unless it is mentioned otherwise, times sequence in this paper is kept as 1-15-1-15 in seconds.
